description: This file implements the Redis-based grain directory for Orleans, providing methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, and lifecycle management of grain addresses using Redis as the backend store.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectory
classes.description: A Redis-backed implementation of the Orleans grain directory, managing grain address registration, lookup, and unregistration with Redis as the storage backend.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the grain address associated with a given GrainId from Redis.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in Redis, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from Redis.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Stub method for unregistering silos, currently a no-op.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the directory to the silo lifecycle events for initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and database, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: Uninitialize
methods.description: Cleans up Redis connection resources during shutdown.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Generates the Redis key for a given GrainId.
